description: One Discord bot per agent. Create the bot in the Discord Developer Portal, invite it to your server, and paste its token here.

botToken.title: Bot token
botToken.description: Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token. Stored encrypted; never shown again.

respondToMentions.title: Answer mentions and replies
respondToMentions.description: Answer when someone @mentions the bot or replies to one of its messages in a server channel.

respondInThreads.title: Keep answering in threads
respondInThreads.description: Once the bot has spoken in a thread, answer every message there without needing a mention. Requires the Message Content intent.

respondToReactions.title: Notify the agent of reactions
respondToReactions.description: When someone adds an emoji reaction to one of the bot's messages, tell the agent. It answers only if the reaction calls for it. Notifications cost agent turns; ones that arrive together share a turn.

replyInThread.title: Answer in a new thread
replyInThread.description: When mentioned in a channel, open a thread on that message and answer there. Each thread is its own conversation. Off: answer in the channel, one conversation per channel.

respondToDMs.title: Answer direct messages
respondToDMs.description: Anyone who shares a server with the bot can DM it. Turn this on only together with an allowed-users list, or for a bot in servers you trust.

messageContentIntent.title: Use the Message Content intent
messageContentIntent.description: Lets the bot read messages that do not mention it (thread follow-ups, un-pinged replies, channel history). Must also be enabled in the Developer Portal → Bot → Privileged Gateway Intents.

historyLimit.title: Channel history as context
historyLimit.description: How many earlier messages of the channel are given to the agent when a conversation starts (0-100). 0 turns it off.

batchWindowSeconds.title: Batch window (seconds)
batchWindowSeconds.description: Messages and reactions that arrive in the same conversation within this many seconds of the first one are delivered to the agent together (0-30). 0 delivers each as soon as it arrives.

allowedUserIds.title: Allowed users
allowedUserIds.description: Comma-separated Discord user IDs the bot answers. Empty: everyone.

allowedGuildIds.title: Allowed servers
allowedGuildIds.description: Comma-separated server (guild) IDs. Empty: every server the bot was invited to.

allowedChannelIds.title: Allowed channels
allowedChannelIds.description: Comma-separated channel IDs. Threads follow their parent channel. Empty: every channel the bot can see.
